Prayer Room🙏

✝️Share your burden. Pray for others. We are family. No one prays alone here.
This is more than a wall, it is an altar where hearts meet. Come as you are — broken, grateful, anxious, hopeful. Drop your prayer and pick up someone else's burden in prayer.
When you pray for one, heaven remembers you too. We may be from different places, but in Christ we are one family, standing in the gap for each other day and night.
Your story matters, your prayer counts, and God is listening right now.✝️
